python: Strengthen Python fundamentals, OOP, and data structures.
sql: Practice joins, window functions, aggregations, and optimization.
docker: Learn Docker images, containers, volumes, and Docker Compose.
aws: Learn EC2, S3, IAM, and deployment basics.
kubernetes: Learn pods, deployments, services, and orchestration.
tensorflow: Build and train deep learning models using TensorFlow.
pytorch: Practice building neural networks and custom training loops.
opencv: Work on image processing and computer vision projects.
yolo: Build object detection projects using YOLO.
nlp: Learn text preprocessing, embeddings, and transformer models.
bert: Understand fine-tuning and inference with BERT models.
transformers: Practice Hugging Face pipelines and model training.
